research_subquestion: Can LPWM particles become useful object-level future units in ego-moving NAVSIM scenes after bounded adaptation?
checkpoint: official Sketchy best LPIPS; strict load; verified MEGA MAC
loss: official temporal ELBO + official MSE/LPIPS reconstruction; all model weights adapted
scenario_definition: ordered: projected overlap >=0.35; else yaw range >=15 degrees; else yaw range <=5 degrees and speed >=1 m/s. Retrospective labels used for reporting only.
training_inputs: RGB; rotation-stabilized variant additionally uses calibration and observed camera pose. No boxes, tracks, future ego intent, or planning supervision.
forecast_causality: pass only 4 observed images; use_all_ctx=False; future camera transform extrapolated from last 2 observed rotations; no future GT pose at inference
selection: predeclared hash and recording round-robin; final update checkpoint only; no development tuning or best-of-N rollout selection
limits: Projected boxes are not segmentation or verified visibility
Particle index is patch identity, not persistent instance identity
Camera rotation compensation does not remove translation/parallax
Planning/PDMS efficacy is outside this representation pilot
